newsitem.title: USA: NBA-FORMER NBA ALL-STAR ALVIN ROBERTSON JAILED.
newsitem.headline: NBA-FORMER NBA ALL-STAR ALVIN ROBERTSON JAILED.

text.p: A Texas judge on Monday sentenced two-time NBA all-star Alvin Robertson to 180 days in jail for burglarizing his girlfriend's apartment.
Robertson, 33, was convicted last month on charges that in June 1995 he broke into the apartment of Sharon Raeford, took her jewelry and slashed her furniture and clothes.
Robertson, who starred for the San Antonio Spurs and Milwaukee Bucks, was a member of the expansion Toronto Raptors last year, but is currently an unrestricted free agent.

The same jury that convicted him gave him a probated sentence, but state district judge Ray Angelini ordered him to serve 180 days in the Bexar County Jail and to pay Raeford $27,000 in restitution. Robertson faced up to 20 years in jail for the felony burglary conviction.

Robertson testified during his trial that the incident arose from a "love-jealous" relationship he had with Raeford, who was his mistress for nine years. Robertson's wife of 11 years, Jackie, testified in his defence.
Robertson was convicted in 1990 for assaulting his wife and again in 1994 for assaults on two women. He was given probated sentences in each case.
In August, he was arrested again and slapped with five other charges for vandalising Raeford's car and resisting arrest.
